subproblem.title: Integer lattice chains Σ_F β_F[[F]] are integer multiplicity currents (Simon Ch. 6, 5.1, the chain P is integer multiplicity; step 6 of the parent proof)
subproblem.statement: Conventions (as in the selected node): ℝ^P = Euclid P, ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hᵈ = μHE[d], e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^P, x_i the i-th coordinate. n := m + 1. For a pair p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P): Φ_p(y) := z + Σ_{j<n} y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ ℝⁿ (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)); e_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}); Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} with Lebesgue measure (volume); F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for i ∈ range ι, x_i = z_i for i ∉ range ι} (the closed unit face of the selected node's statement); A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (the open face). 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d (domain univ throughout); ∂X = X.boundary; M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass (Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm); IMRep and IsIntegerMultiplicity are the contract notions. Statement: let P, m ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of pairs p = (z, ι) with every ι strictly increasing, β : (pairs) → ℤ, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} β_p·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P). Then T is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity T: some IMRep in univ represents T).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (β : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → ℤ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), T ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (β p : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1 (the lattice chain P = Σ_F β_F[[F]] with β_F ∈ ℤ is integer multiplicity; "the fact that P, R are integer multiplicity ... should be evident"), in the form of step 6 of the parent proof (an explicit IMRep carried by open faces, whose approximate tangent spaces are the face planes V_ι, oriented by ±e_ι). Dependencies: FG = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_fr_face_geometry; LPT = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_fr_local_plane_tangent. For p = (z, ι) ∈ s: A_p := Φ_p(Q₁), F_p the closed face, V_p := span{e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}} (dim V_p = n, the e_{ι(k)} being orthonormal), and e_p^* the n-vector α ↦ α(e_p) (evaluation at e_p, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors; in Lean ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ e_p : MultiVector P n). Let s' := {p ∈ s : β_p ≠ 0} and sgn(β_p) ∈ {1, −1} for p ∈ s'.

1. Face facts (FG). For p ∈ s: Φ_p is an isometry (FG(6)), hence 1-Lipschitz, a closed embedding and a measurable embedding; A_p ⊆ F_p (FG(5)), A_p is Borel; F_p is closed (FG(8)) and nonempty; Hⁿ(F_p) = 1 (FG(2)) and Hⁿ⌞F_p = Φ_p#(volume⌞Q₁) (FG(3)); A_p ∩ F_q = ∅ for q ∈ s, q ≠ p (FG(9)), so the A_p (p ∈ s) are pairwise disjoint and Hⁿ(A_p) ≤ 1. For every bounded Borel h : ℝ^P → ℝ, since Φ_p(y) ∈ A_p for y ∈ Q₁, ∫_{A_p} h dHⁿ = ∫_{F_p} 1_{A_p}h dHⁿ = ∫_{Q₁} h(Φ_p(y)) dy (FG(4)).

2. The triple. Let N := ⋃_{p∈s'} A_p, θ(x) := Σ_{p∈s'} |β_p|·1_{A_p}(x) ∈ ℕ, and ξ(x) := Σ_{p∈s'} sgn(β_p)·1_{A_p}(x)·e_p^*. By disjointness, θ = |β_p| ≥ 1 and ξ = sgn(β_p)·e_p^* on A_p for p ∈ s', while θ = 0 and ξ = 0 off N.

3. The measurability and integrability fields. N is Borel and N ⊆ univ. N is countably n-rectifiable, directly from the definition (CountablyRectifiable n N: there are M₀ with Hⁿ(M₀) = 0 and Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, j ∈ ℕ, with N ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j range F_j): take M₀ := ∅ and, enumerating s' = {p_0, …, p_{r−1}} (s'.equivFin), F_j := Φ_{p_j} for j < r and F_j := the constant map 0 for j ≥ r; each Φ_p is 1-Lipschitz (FG(6)) and N = ⋃_{p∈s'} A_p ⊆ ⋃_{p∈s'} range Φ_p ⊆ ⋃_j range F_j (this also covers s' = ∅). θ is Borel (a finite sum of constants times indicators of Borel sets) and θ > 0 on N. For every compact K', ∫⁻_{N∩K'} θ dHⁿ ≤ Σ_{p∈s'} |β_p|·Hⁿ(A_p) ≤ Σ_{p∈s'} |β_p| < ∞. ξ takes finitely many values on finitely many Borel sets, so it is strongly measurable, in particular AE-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞N.

4. Approximate tangent spaces and orientation at every point of N. Let x ∈ N; then x ∈ A_p for exactly one p ∈ s', and x = Φ_p(y₀) with y₀ ∈ Q₁. Let r₁ := min_k min(y₀_k, 1 − y₀_k) > 0 and, for q ∈ s' ∖ {p}, r_q := infDist(x, F_q) > 0 (x ∉ F_q by step 1, F_q closed and nonempty; IsClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos); let r > 0 be the minimum of r₁ and the r_q. Let |y − x| < r. If y ∈ N, then y ∈ A_q ⊆ F_q for some q ∈ s'; q ≠ p is impossible because |y − x| < r_q = infDist(x, F_q) ≤ dist(x, y); so y = Φ_p(y₁) with y₁ ∈ Q₁, and y − x = Σ_k (y₁_k − y₀_k) e_{ι(k)} ∈ V_p. Conversely, if y − x ∈ V_p, then (y − x)_i = 0 for i ∉ range ι, so y − x = Σ_k c_k e_{ι(k)} with c_k := (y − x)_{ι(k)} and |c| = |y − x| < r ≤ r₁; hence 0 < y₀_k + c_k < 1 for all k and y = Φ_p(y₀ + c) ∈ A_p ⊆ N. Thus y ∈ N ⟺ y − x ∈ V_p for |y − x| < r, and LPT gives HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V_p. Moreover ξ(x) = sgn(β_p)·e_p^*, where e_p is an orthonormal family spanning V_p; so IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) V_p holds with τ := e_p (first alternative if β_p > 0, second if β_p < 0). This holds at every x ∈ N, in particular for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ N. Hence R := (N, θ, ξ) is an IMRep in univ.

5. R represents T. Let ω be a test n-form. The function x ↦ θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) is Borel, bounded (|ω(x)(e_p)| ≤ sup‖ω‖) and vanishes off N; on A_p (p ∈ s') it equals |β_p| sgn(β_p) ω(x)(e_p) = β_p ω(x)(e_p), and it is integrable on each A_p (Hⁿ(A_p) ≤ 1). By disjointness (integral_biUnion_finset) and step 1, R.action(ω) = Σ_{p∈s'} β_p ∫_{A_p} ω(x)(e_p) dHⁿ(x) = Σ_{p∈s'} β_p ∫_{Q₁} ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} β_p ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy (integral_const_mul; the terms with β_p = 0 vanish) = T(ω). So R represents T, and T is integer multiplicity. ∎
proof_key_steps: Carrier: the disjoint union N of the open faces A_p with β_p ≠ 0; multiplicity |β_p| and orientation sgn(β_p)·e_p^* on A_p.
Borel measurability, countable n-rectifiability (isometric parametrizations Φ_p) and local integrability (Hⁿ(A_p) ≤ 1).
Near each x ∈ A_p, N coincides with x + V_p (the other closed faces are at positive distance), so local_plane_tangent gives the approximate tangent space V_p, unit-oriented by ±e_p.
Face by face, Hⁿ⌞F_p = Φ_p#(volume⌞Q₁) turns the action of (N, θ, ξ) into Σ_p ∫_{Q₁} β_p ω(Φ_p y)(e_p) dy = T(ω).
